title: Engine Coolant Over-Temperature Diagnostics (P0217 / OBD-II PID 0x05)
symptoms: Sustained ECT > 105°C under nominal cruising load
Rapid temperature spike on gradient climb
Heater core blowing cool air during idle
rootCauses: Coolant pump impeller cavitation or belt slippage
Severe radiator fin blockage from highway debris
System pressure loss from cracked expansion reservoir
recommendedAction: Do not open pressure cap when hot. Allow engine to drop below 60°C. Pressure test cooling loop to 1.2 bar. Replace thermostat assembly (OEM #5424) and flush with ethylene-glycol 50:50 premix.

title: 12V Auxiliary Electrical Bus Voltage Sag (P0562 / OBD-II PID 0x42)
symptoms: System potential dropping below 12.4V with headlights and AC active
ECU rebooting during heavy starter cranking
rootCauses: High-resistance ground strap connection at chassis
Sulfated lead-acid starter battery with high internal resistance
recommendedAction: Perform AC ripple voltage test across battery terminals (<0.5V AC nominal). Inspect alternator B+ terminal for thermal discoloration. Replace diode pack and bench test regulator output.

title: Cylinder Specific Misfire Pattern (P0300 - P0304 / SAE J1939 PID 0x0C)
symptoms: Engine shuddering under low-RPM high-torque demand
rootCauses: Direct ignition coil dielectric breakdown under heat soak
Clogged high-pressure direct fuel injector nozzle
recommendedAction: Swap ignition coil to adjacent cylinder to verify fault migration. Inspect plug insulator for tracking lines. Run injector flow balance test. Replace affected coil and install fresh iridium plugs.

title: High-Voltage EV Traction Pack Degradation & Cell Imbalance (P0A80)
symptoms: Rapid state of charge drop during regenerative braking
State of Health (SoH) decreasing faster than ARAI warranty curve
Pack temperature delta exceeding 8°C across modules
rootCauses: Lithium dendrite growth on degraded parallel cell groups
BMS passive balancing harness resistance drift
Cooling plate thermal interface paste drying out
recommendedAction: Connect certified diagnostic tool. Run static cell balance cycle at 100% SoC. Measure open-circuit voltage variance across all 96 series cells (<30mV nominal). Replace balancing harness if drift exceeds 120mV.
